review.note: The flagged '~' is the approximately sign inside quotations from the paper ('uptake ~ 2.5 wt% at −196 °C and ~ 0.8 Mpa') in the assessment the agent writes. The text sits in a heredoc with a quoted delimiter (<<'EOF'), so the shell expands nothing in it, and the '~' is never a path. The command changes to the agent's own run directory (which holds only its own in, out and work directories) and runs python3 -I on the heredoc to write its own output file; no other path is named.
